preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 20 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and 1 <= n <= 10 for n in [int(line.strip()) for line in stdin_text.splitlines()[1::2] if line.strip()])
preconditions.description: For each test case, n is an integer between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(isinstance(x, int) and -100000 <= x <= 100000 for x in a) for a in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin_text.splitlines()[2::2] if line.strip()])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the sequence a consists of n integers, each between -10^5 and 10^5 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(line in ['YES', 'NO'] for line in stdout_text.strip().splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each output line is either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all((line == 'YES') == (any(all(any(a_val == b[j] - b[k] for k in range(n)) for j in range(n)) for a_val in a) for b in [[x for x in range(-200000, 200001) for _ in range(n)]]) for line, n, a in zip(stdout_text.strip().splitlines(), [int(line.strip()) for line in stdin_text.splitlines()[1::2] if line.strip()], [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin_text.splitlines()[2::2] if line.strip()]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is 'YES' if and only if there exists a sequence b of n integers such that every element a_i in the input sequence can be expressed as the difference of two elements from b (b_j - b_k for some indices j, k).
